question: A village shop had 15 cartons of eggs on Monday morning. Customers bought 12 of them during the day. A delivery driver then damaged 1 carton, which was thrown away. By Wednesday the shop's carton count had grown to 2 times what had been left on Monday evening. A farm delivery added 52 more cartons on Thursday. Every carton in the shop holds 9 eggs, and the shop lists its opening times in minutes past the hour rather than in hours. How many eggs does the shop have?

A card factory stores 173 boxes, and every box holds 9 packs. A short delivery added 61 packs, and a returned order brought back 7 more. Each pack in the store contains 7 cards. Every card comes with 2 stickers sealed inside it. A supplier then sent 26 loose stickers to the same store. How many stickers are in the store altogether?

On Friday morning Leila filled 130 trays, and each tray held 9 pastries. Before lunch a helper added 32 more pastries that had been baked overnight. Her business partner Yusuf then baked twice as many pastries as Leila was holding at that moment. In the afternoon Yusuf's second oven gave him another 56 pastries. Through the evening 1816 of Yusuf's pastries were sold at the market. How many pastries does Yusuf have left?

In the morning a joiner had 95 planks in the workshop and collected 65 more from the timber yard. Each plank was cut into 3 equal pieces. At midday the pieces were shared equally between 5 sheds, and the pieces in the first shed were then divided equally between 4 workbenches. Every piece on the first bench needs 8 nails to fix it in place. In the evening the joiner found 53 loose nails in a jar and added them to that bench's supply. The timber yard charges 12 pounds for delivery. How many nails are on the first bench?

A theatre workshop had 17 rolls of gaffer tape in its cupboard. It threw out 3 rolls whose glue had dried up. An order from the supplier then brought in 53 more rolls. Every roll holds 9 metres of tape. Building the set used up 136 metres. The workshop has been running for a dozen seasons. How many metres of tape are left?

A grain depot began the week with 217 sacks. A farm delivered 26 more, a second farm sent 21, and a co-operative added 24. Every sack in the depot weighs 7 kilograms. The whole stock was then divided equally between 4 village shops, and the Bridge Street shop took the first share. How many kilograms of grain went to the Bridge Street shop?

In the morning a printer had 163 reams in the store and a courier brought 22 more. By the afternoon a bulk order had raised the store's ream count to 2 times that total. Every ream contains 8 blocks of paper, and each block holds 9 sheets. In the evening the whole stock of sheets was shared equally between 6 print rooms, and the first room took its share straight away. How many sheets went to the first print room?

Early in the morning Rafa stacked 20 pallets in the depot, and each pallet carried 9 crates. Every crate holds 9 boxes. During the afternoon the checkers found that each box contains 4 trays, and every tray holds 9 sachets. In the evening his colleague Bea, who had handled fewer pallets than Rafa, shared all of the sachets equally between 6 vans, and the first van drove off at once. Bea logs her shifts in minutes rather than hours. How many sachets went out on the first van?

A model shop received 158 kits and sent 20 of them back because parts were missing. Every kit that stayed contains 4 sprues. Each sprue holds 8 small plastic pieces. A supplier sent 33 loose pieces to replace breakages. Each piece needs 3 drops of glue to fix it in place. The shop has been open for a dozen years. How many drops of glue would the whole stock need?

Bea started the charity walk with 72 pounds already pledged. Her neighbour Karl, who raised far less than she did, handed her 32 pounds from his collection tin. A shop added 15 pounds, and her workplace matched that with 60 pounds. A late online gift brought another 18 pounds. Bank charges then took 26 pounds off the total. Bea has walked this route for a dozen years. How many pounds has Bea raised?

Early in the morning a bottling shed filled 198 crates on each of its 6 lines. Before lunch 559 crates went out on the first lorry. During the afternoon a second lorry took 574 crates away from the yard. In the evening 29 crates were set aside as damaged and removed. The shed times its production runs in minutes rather than hours. How many crates are left in the yard?

Marek had 49 seed trays and gave 18 of them to the allotment society. Each tray he kept holds 4 pots. Every pot grew 9 sunflower seedlings this spring. His friend Odette, who planted fewer trays than Marek, gave him 7 spare seedlings, and the garden centre added 17 more. A school then took 823 seedlings for its planting day. How many seedlings does Marek have left?

A stationery works packed 183 cartons on each of 5 days. A returned order added 44 cartons to the same stack. Every carton in the stack holds 9 notebooks. A small delivery brought 80 loose notebooks to join them. A national chain then bought 5372 notebooks from the works. The following month the works produced enough to double the number of notebooks it was holding. How many notebooks does the works hold now?

Nadia had 192 metres of ribbon on her roll and bought 31 metres more at the haberdashery. A large order used up 203 metres of it. Each metre still on the roll can be cut into 4 short lengths for gift tags. Her assistant Ravi, who works far more slowly than Nadia, spoiled 34 of those short lengths while practising. Every good length left is then folded into 4 loops for the tags. The haberdashery sells ribbon in reels of 25 metres, and Nadia has shopped there for a dozen years. How many loops can be made?

A club had 141 raffle books in the cupboard and sent 56 of them to the school. Another 19 books were found to be misprinted and were destroyed. The printer replaced those with 17 fresh books. Every book still in the cupboard contains 5 tickets. A second cupboard was then filled so that the two cupboards together held 2 times the number of tickets in the first. The club records its meeting lengths in minutes rather than hours. How many tickets do the two cupboards hold altogether?

A hardware depot has 224 racks in the main hall and 43 more in the annexe. Every rack holds 8 shelves. Each shelf carries 4 boxes, and every box contains 9 bolts. The depot's forklift can lift 900 kilograms. Stock-taking times are recorded on the depot sheets in minutes rather than hours. How many bolts does the depot hold in total?

A ferry company had 212 life jackets in its store. An inspection condemned 17 of them as worn out. Another 42 went down to the small boats at the jetty. The summer fleet then took 144 more out of the store. A repair shop returned 12 jackets it had mended, and a supplier delivered 23 new ones. The ferry carries 180 passengers, and the crew logs its safety drills in minutes rather than hours. How many life jackets are in the store now?

A bakery packs 131 boxes of shortbread on each of 3 shifts. Quality control pulled 31 boxes off the line as underweight. A returned pallet then added 26 boxes back to the stack. A late shift produced another 13 boxes before closing. The bakery's main oven is 4 metres wide. How many boxes are on the stack now?

A jam maker had 14 crates in the shed and sent 8 of them to a farm shop. Every crate still in the shed holds 4 jars. A market stall returned 51 unsold jars to the shed. Customers at the gate then bought 64 jars over the weekend. A new batch added 59 jars to the same shelf. The jars were finally split equally between 2 delivery vans, and the first van set off at once. The shed roof needs 30 new tiles. How many jars went out on the first van?

Ravi counted 194 chairs in the community centre and moved 87 of them into the storeroom. A neighbouring hall then lent the centre 53 chairs for the festival. All the chairs still out on the field were shared equally between 5 marquees. Ravi's colleague Sinead, who had brought fewer chairs than Ravi counted, added 17 from her own van to the first marquee. Rain damage cost that marquee 24 chairs, and a further 5 were carried off to the stage. The centre bills its hire in minutes rather than hours. How many chairs are left in the first marquee?

A tea packer loads 52 pallets onto each of 5 lorries. Every pallet carries 9 cases. Each case holds 4 cartons, and every carton contains 4 boxes of tea. How many boxes of tea leave the packing plant on those lorries?

A florist had 46 buckets of roses and sold 37 of them to a wedding planner. A grower delivered 7 more buckets that afternoon. Every bucket in the shop holds 6 stems. The florist used 93 stems making arrangements for a hotel. A late delivery brought 76 loose stems to the workroom. The shop prices its flowers in cents rather than dollars. How many stems does the florist have?

A hotel laundry uses 18 trolleys, and each trolley carries 9 bags. Every bag holds 6 sheets. Each sheet is hung with 5 pegs, and the housekeeper set out exactly that many pegs. She then found 21 more pegs in a drawer and put them out with the others. The laundry has been running for a dozen years. How many pegs are set out altogether?

Hana filled 98 boxes on each of 7 days at the packing shed. Her colleague Bertil, who filled fewer boxes than Hana every single day, added 77 boxes of his own to her stack. A lorry then took 552 boxes from that stack down to the port. A late return brought 10 boxes back to the shed. Hana has worked here for a dozen seasons. How many boxes are on the stack now?

A school ordered 162 exercise books in September, and by November its order for the year had doubled. A separate delivery added 60 more books to the same store. Every book in the store contains 6 sections of squared paper. A supplier then sent 42 loose sections to be pasted into damaged books. The store cupboard sits at the end of the corridor. How many sections of squared paper does the school have?
